item.title: Pulaski County woman seriously injured in Highway Y crash

item.title: Warm winter weather the big story for the first week of the new year
item.description: December will end with a quiet finish and a continuation of the very dry pattern, while temperatures will rebound to near normal levels and remain warm through the end of next week, with a storm possibly bringing some thunder and colder weather in the second half of January.

item.title: Discovery Center's winter program offers fun learning
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — For many parents, school breaks can mean scrambling to find safe, engaging and educational care options for their children. Springfield’s Discovery Center is offering a hands-on solution that combines learning with play. item.title: "Great for us": Springfield businesses discuss raising minimum wage in Missouri
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Missouri workers will see a minimum wage increase of $1.25 on Jan. 1, raising the rate from $13.75 to $15 per hour. With this adjustment, Missouri joins 20 other states in increasing their minimum wage. However, Arkansas will remain unchanged at $11 an hour after its last adjustment in 2021. The increase [...]

item.title: Second man arrested in string of burglaries in Polk County
item.description: Skyler Johnson, 19, was arrested and charged with nine felonies, including four counts of second-degree burglary, three counts of felony stealing, and two counts of first-degree property damage, in connection with multiple burglaries in Polk County, Missouri, which resulted in an estimated $25,796.08 in stolen items and $5,400 in property damage.

item.title: Early morning fire destroys two homes in Taney County
item.description: Two houses were destroyed in an early morning fire near Forsyth, displacing two families and leaving the cause of the fire still under investigation.

item.title: Pedestrian killed, driver arrested in Barry County crash
item.description: An 84-year-old woman was killed and 42-year-old Amberel Macdermant was arrested after a crash near Purdy, Missouri, on Monday night, with Macdermant charged with DWI death of another.
